excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
I think the mistake on our side was that we should have been using the released version on devnet. This way, we can make sure that what we release is what we’re actually testing.

Going forward, I think that for further Glamsterdam testing, we should use version 2.1. Perhaps this could become the process for all clients: once a version for a fork is released, that released version should be used for further testing, unless a client specifically wants to test something else.

Thanks, pandas (<@199561711278227457> and team) for running the shadowfork with the released version! 🙏
